about: Staged per-opening photo reads (photoRead.ts). One record per opening of a modelled host, read on a dated Gemeente Amsterdam panorama (CC BY 4.0). status published = drawn by default after a won blind A/B; staged = only with ?retailFit=1. Lane retail-fit-20261120.

hirschgebouw.review: Published 2026-11-20 after two blind A/B rounds (one fresh opus judge each, photo | A | B at the panorama poses, sides seeded): round 1 4/4, round 2 (interiors darkened to the measured glass tone, Rijksmuseum poster) 4/4. Judge notes left: Geldmaat panel too white, AH lettering at the far right not legible in every photo.

american-hotel.review: Published 2026-11-20. Blind A/B, a fresh opus judge per round: Bar Américain front won (med); the Leidsekade front first LOST (curtains and lamps against the daylight photo's lowered blinds, low), the read was corrected to pale blinds and won against a new judge (med). Judge notes left: the blind's dark lower strip too even; no entrance canopy (model).

magna-plaza.review: Published 2026-11-20: blind A/B, one fresh opus judge, two 2025-01-09 panorama poses: fit won 2/2. Re-staged 2026-11-21 (round 8) against the rebuilt GLB (main 9888e874ee, its own glass slot): stage-openings.ts --maxSill=2.9 --maxTop=7.5 finds 38 openings (shop panes sill 2.75 m / crown 7.4 m, pavilion arches 0.75 / 7.35 m); all 24 reads land in their own opening (the old staged openings hit 2 on the new GLB). The glassShop retag patch is dropped. Blind vs main (fresh opus judge, sides seeded, artifacts/retail-fit/blind-magna-r8): fit 2/0, both high. Judge notes: posters too small and too pink (the photo has tall SALE and red 50 panels), one invented, one missing; flat glass with no reflection; one far-right shop pane still blue.
